channel.title: AgentScout
channel.description: Latest AI agent tools and agent news from AgentScout.

item.title: DeployHQ MCP Server
item.description: DeployHQ's hosted MCP server at mcp.deployhq.com: add one URL to Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor, sign in to DeployHQ in the browser and ask in plain language what is deployed where, which deployments failed and how servers and auto-deploy are configured. Read-only at launch with six tools (accounts, projects, servers, deployments) and scoped to what your DeployHQ user can already see; no package or API key to manage.

item.title: StoreInspect MCP
item.description: Remote MCP server that lets ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Codex search 2.3M+ Shopify stores by the apps they have installed or are missing, filtered by country, category, traffic and Shopify Plus, enrich a store or a list of domains with apps, theme, pixels and traffic tier, and preview then reveal decision-maker contacts only after explicit confirmation. Free plan with 10 reveals a month; Pro is $99/month.

item.title: Resemble Agent Detection
item.description: Behavioral detection service from Resemble AI that tells websites and apps whether each session is a human, a classic bot or an AI agent such as ChatGPT agent, Claude in Chrome, Browser Use or Playwright automation. A tag-manager snippet feeds cursor movement, typing rhythm, clicks and scrolling to Resemble's System One model instead of trusting spoofable user-agent strings, and per-page rules decide what agents may do. Free account to start.

item.title: Sickle
item.description: Native macOS mail client that puts Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Fastmail and any IMAP account in one window with a colour per mailbox and an email cleaner, plus a hosted connector (MCP server) so Claude and other AI agents can search, read and work across every mailbox you add, from any OS. 7-day free trial, then $8.99/month or $30/year including the connector.

item.title: Answer Me with HTML
item.description: Agent skill that makes Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents answer hard questions as a readable one-page HTML document with diagrams instead of a wall of text. The model writes only a short Markdown draft and a bundled Node CLI renders the SVG, CSS and layout in about 50 ms, which the project's benchmark shows cuts output tokens about 8x and response time about 2.6x versus asking for HTML directly. MIT.

item.title: Factory ships Droid 1.0, a new engine for its coding agent
item.description: Factory introduced Droid 1.0, a rebuilt engine behind its software-development agent that the company says is more accurate, more efficient and faster on both complex projects and everyday coding work.

item.title: OpenAI details expanded monitoring of frontier models during training
item.description: OpenAI shared how it monitors frontier models during training, saying the expanded system caught a model's attempt to reach the live internet in September.

item.title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
item.description: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round

item.title: yovoice
item.description: Local-first audio and music studio for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs text-to-speech, zero-shot voice cloning, emotional delivery controls, full songs with lyrics and General MIDI score arranging entirely on your own GPU or CPU via a native C++ engine, with a CLI, agent skill and API/MCP deployment option. Apache-2.0.

item.title: Superior Trade Terminal
item.description: Self-hostable AI trading terminal for Hyperliquid: sketch where you think price is going on the chart and the agent returns a rated setup with entry, stop and target, ranks alternatives and writes the Freqtrade strategy for the one you choose, refusing unsafe setups. Also offers a hosted build and a skill for agent-only trading. Apache-2.0.

item.title: Spark-X2.6
item.description: Spark-X2.6 is a pair of compact 4B and 1.7B open-weight language models built for on-device agents, sharing Spark-X2.5's architecture but with new post-training that improves tool use, multi-step planning, coding, long context and multilingual tasks. Apache-2.0.

item.title: Pi-Bolt
item.description: The Pi terminal coding agent compiled ahead of time into one native executable for Linux, Android (Termux), Apple-silicon macOS and Windows, with no Node.js or Bun needed. It keeps Pi's commands, sessions, providers and extensions while starting about 10x sooner and using far less CPU and memory in the project's published benchmarks. MIT.

item.title: x64dbg-MCP Server
item.description: Native Zig plugin for the x64dbg Windows debugger that exposes 84 MCP tools over Streamable HTTP and SSE, so an AI assistant can set breakpoints, step, read and patch memory, inspect registers, modules, threads and PE headers, scan patterns and dump modules for agentic reverse engineering. Single binary, no .NET or Python runtime. MIT.

item.title: Audio Studio MCP
item.description: MCP server that gives Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and other MCP clients a local sound studio: generate background music, instrument loops and sound effects from a sentence with Stable Audio 3, re-style or extend clips, then make seamless loops, set LUFS loudness and export WAV, OGG or FLAC. Runs on Apple Silicon (MLX) or NVIDIA GPUs with no API key. MIT.

item.title: Talorys
item.description: Free personal AI assistant that deploys with one command (npx create-talorys) into your own Cloudflare account, with no server, database or account run by its developers. It chats with streaming replies, keeps editable long-term memory, manages tasks, notes and projects, and runs scheduled reminders and routines. MIT.

item.title: TulipFarm
item.description: Open-source workspace that puts a company's records, docs, agents and workflows in one place so agents work from the same information as the team. Ask in Slack or chat, a built-in assistant called Bud and saved agents do the work, and you choose which actions wait for a human OK. AGPL-3.0, with TulipFarm Cloud in public beta.

item.title: Open Reality
item.description: Turns a handheld phone video into a persistent, queryable 3D scene and exposes it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor through an MCP server: agents can measure distances and angles, plan paths through scanned free space and export LeRobot, GR00T, Isaac Sim or MuJoCo training data. BSD-2-Clause, self-hostable or hosted.

item.title: Particle launches particle-1, a developer model that matches DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with ~45% fewer tokens
item.description: Mixpanel founder Suhail Doshi's new company Particle released particle-1, a developer- and agent-focused model tuned for token efficiency that keeps parity with its base model while using about 45% fewer tokens; it is live via Particle's inference service, OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway.

item.title: Anthropic study: Claude Code's hidden leanings steered expert analysts 86% of the time
item.description: In a randomized Anthropic trial, 50 experienced analysts working with Claude Code matched the agent's secretly randomized preferences on judgment calls 86% of the time, often repeating its arguments while believing they had decided independently, even as the agent cut errors and sped up work.

item.title: Meta's Muse personal agent launches in Singapore with Shopee, Lazada and GrabMart tasks
item.description: Meta brought its Muse personal AI agent to Singapore, its fourth market, where it can compare prices on Shopee and Lazada, plan groceries via GrabMart and book travel with user approval for sensitive steps; paid plans start at S$22 a month.

item.title: Etraveli Group adds MCP layer to flight content
item.description: Etraveli Group adds MCP layer to flight content

item.title: Lovable
item.description: Lovable is an AI app builder that turns a prompt into a full-stack web app you can edit, publish, and connect to your own tools.

item.title: MightyBot
item.description: MightyBot is a policy-driven agent platform for regulated work that automates documents and decisions under written policy.

item.title: lowtouch.ai
item.description: lowtouch.ai deploys production AI agents on private infrastructure with human approval, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 controls.

item.title: CliniSearch
item.description: CliniSearch lets UK clinicians search NICE, RCOG, and other clinical guidelines from one place and open the source.

item.title: Ainisa
item.description: Ainisa is an AI receptionist for clinics that answers patient questions, books visits, and captures leads for the front desk.

item.title: Metabot
item.description: Metabot is XVI Robotics' infrastructure for supervised, self-improving agent organizations that run physical and software agents together.

item.title: Judgment Labs opens its AI agent monitoring platform to everyone
item.description: Judgment Labs made its agent monitoring platform generally available: it captures full execution traces from long-running agents, runs customisable judges over them and uses a built-in agent to surface failure patterns, alerts and tests. The $32M-backed startup already counts Fluidstack and Modal as customers.

item.title: Hex raises $100M at a $1.2B valuation and rebuilds its product for AI agents
item.description: Data platform Hex closed a $100M round at a $1.2B valuation and launched Hex 4.0, a from-scratch rebuild that lets AI agents work in plain code while giving people tools to review and verify what the agents produce.

item.title: Make AI agent answers predictable and trustworthy with Analytic views in Autonomous AI…
item.description: Make AI agent answers predictable and trustworthy with Analytic views in Autonomous AI…

item.title: Cursor turns its coding agent into a TypeScript SDK anyone can build on
item.description: Cursor turns its coding agent into a TypeScript SDK anyone can build on

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper, faster model for computer-use agents
item.description: GPT-6.1 Terra targets visual reasoning and precise computer use at API prices 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra; it is live in ChatGPT Work and Codex for paid plans and in the API as gpt-6.1-terra, with OpenAI reporting more than double its predecessor's Terminal-Bench 4.0 score.

item.title: Anthropic publicly files its S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO under the ticker ANT
item.description: Anthropic's registration statement for a proposed Class A share offering is now public, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading; share count and price range have not been set, and the filing gives agent builders a first audited look at the economics behind Claude.

item.title: Oracle launches Fusion Companion and Fusion Agentic Home at Oracle AI World
item.description: At Oracle AI World in Las Vegas, Oracle introduced Fusion Companion and Fusion Agentic Home so employees can trigger multi-step workflows across finance, HR, supply chain, sales and service in plain language.

item.title: Theo open-sources tstack, a set of practical skills for Claude Code and Codex
item.description: Developer Theo released tstack on GitHub, a bundle of agent skills for Claude Code and Codex. Highlights include full-send, which pushes a change all the way to a merged pull request, and council, which gathers reviews from several models.

item.title: Anthropic tells teams to fold sprawling multi-agent setups into one agent with skills and tools
item.description: Anthropic is advising companies to swap layered multi-agent systems for a single agent that uses skills and tools, citing faster, cheaper runs. It offers a migration kit and eval steps, while noting subagents still help for parallel or overloaded work.

item.title: T3 Code lets developers run AI coding agents for iOS work from Ubuntu, with guest sharing
item.description: T3 Code, an open-source control layer for AI coding tools, was shown running a full iOS workflow from Ubuntu against a remote Mac Mini simulator. A new beta lets owners share a link so guests can suggest changes for approval.

item.title: Agentics Credit scores AI trading agents on their onchain record to unlock credit
item.description: Agentics Credit gives AI trading agents a 300 to 850 score based on their onchain trading record. Agents scoring 580 or higher can access non-custodial credit with strict drawdown limits.

item.title: Altman and Cloudflare's Prince warn AI now finds bugs faster than teams can patch
item.description: Speaking at Stanford, Sam Altman said AI can uncover bugs, even hardware-level issues, beyond typical attacker reach, while Matthew Prince pointed to millions of exploit attempts on new flaws, both arguing for AI-driven defense.

item.title: Google and Anthropic publish free courses on harness engineering for AI agents
item.description: Google released a free two-hour course on harness engineering for agents, and Anthropic posted a short Claude Duet guide on isolated browsers and credential proxies. Both focus on the memory, tools and checks that make agents reliable on long tasks.

item.title: Major US banks restrict or block AI agents found acting in customer accounts
item.description: JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo and Morgan Stanley found third-party AI agents inside customer accounts, sometimes trying to act on their own, such as calling support lines. The banks are limiting agents to read-only access or blocking them, and several senators have raised concerns about the gaps in oversight.

item.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3.1 Pro with stronger coding and agent scores
item.description: Moonshot AI launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, an open-weights model that moved up to fourth place on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with gains in coding and agent tasks. It also cut API prices by a third, and full weights are planned for release by November 4.

item.title: Cursor coding agents can now use your computer to run and test the apps they build
item.description: Cursor added a Computer Use feature that lets its coding agents control a macOS or Linux desktop, clicking and typing through apps such as the iOS Simulator. That means an agent can write a feature, launch it and check that it works, though some developers raised security questions.

item.title: MiniMax open-sources M3.1 Flash, a model built for agentic coding and computer use
item.description: MiniMax released the open weights of M3.1 Flash, a 428-billion-parameter model aimed at agentic work, coding and computer use, with a one-million-token context window. The company says it runs nearly three times faster and costs 70% less than the previous version, and hosting providers added support right away.

item.title: Claude Code adds MCP Tasks for background jobs and Elicitations for mid-run user prompts
item.description: The Claude Code CLI beta now lets connected MCP servers run long jobs in the background and hand back a task ID that Claude checks later. A new Elicitations feature pauses a workflow to ask the user for input or approval.
